protocol.selection: After exploratory feature and shortlist ablations, compare geography-pool-v1, replay training with income bonus excluded (v2), and replay training preserving the prior objective (v3) on development games. Choose the greater equal mean of world/guided VP excluding the engine income bonus, requiring both agents' original engine mean VP and bonus-excluded mean VP to exceed the baseline. If no candidate qualifies, keep the baseline.
protocol.developmentAmendment: Before selection and any candidate final evaluation, add v3 to separate replay-data effects from the objective change after v2 reduced world-model development VP. No final candidate scores were available or consulted.
protocol.finalEvaluation: Freeze selected checkpoint and planner metadata before running its final matches. Use independent seed groups with four seat rotations. Paired bootstrap over 100 seed groups. Report original engine VP, bonus-excluded VP, income bonus, era scoring components, 150+ frequency, maxima, wins and runtime. Do not use final outcomes to select a different checkpoint.
protocol.scope: This version preserves the existing engine. Excluding its final income bonus does not correct other departures from tabletop rules. Human reports are anecdotal reference scores, not a directly comparable benchmark. Candidate pre-ranking increases computation; this study tests an upgraded player, not equal-compute architectural superiority.
